basics.name: Lindsey Bieda
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Lindsey is a results-driven software engineering manager with a passion for building inclusive, high-performing teams and fostering positive, collaborative cultures. She combines creative vision with strong analytical skills to deliver innovative solutions and empower teams to achieve ambitious goals. Lindsey is dedicated to mentoring talent, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring both business and team success.

work.name: GitHub
highlights: Took over a team of 7 to deliver flagship GitHub Copilot features for GitHub Universe, including Issue Summarization, Pull Request integration, and more.
Led the Copilot for PRs team through a successful transition to a new structure, ensuring continued team effectiveness and morale.
Built and managed a new team of 10 engineers across NA and APAC regions for GitHub Models, a distinct product separate from Copilot.
Successfully led the first public preview launch of GitHub Models at GitHub Universe 2024 and then later public preview of Models now integrated into repositories for Microsoft Build 2025.

work.name: GitHub
highlights: Continued on as the anchor for the discussions team, acting as lead and point of contact for external teams and assuring work was moving forward
Created the standard for how hackathons were run and operated at GitHub based on the success for running hackathons at our organizational level
Developed a pilot program for engineering rotations in order to prevent burnout and increase team morale which quickly became an organizational standard
Worked with the GitHub Sponsors team to ship the GitHub Sposonsors Patreon integatrion which allowed creators an additional route within GitHub Sponsors to receive funding
